verdict.rationale: Statsig documents both a Console API (CRUD API for platform actions) and an HTTP API for retrieving gate/experiment values and logging events without an SDK, giving AI-native users a scriptable, documented public API surface; a CLI and MCP server further support programmatic/agentic access. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s on openapi.json/swagger.json paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
